title: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by
question: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors. For each building, list the building name, building number, total assignable area, total non-assignable area, and total room count, sorted in descending order of the total assignable area.

SELECT 
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(f.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area,
    b.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS total_room_count
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.NUM_OF_ROOMS
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;

react.initial_search_query: Calculate the total assignable and non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors. For each building, list the building name, building number, total assignable area, total non-assignable area, and total room count, sorted in descending order of the total assignable area.

grouping role: non-assignable area for each building by summing up the respective areas of all its floors
aggregation role: sorted in descending order of the total assignable area

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC) SELECT s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.BUILDING_TYPE, s1.hist_record_count, s1.total_assignable_area, s1.avg_hist_num_of_rooms, s2.area_range, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS mit_assignable_area FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR, s1.area_range, s1.area_variance, s2.assignable_area_range, s2.assignable_area_variance, s2.total_room_count FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = s2.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.MAJOR_USE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS rw JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) -
